_about: The stdout contract of the two operator-run enrichment stages. scan is what enrich_prep.py prints; apply is what enrich_apply.py prints. Both are strict: no key beyond these, and the required keys are safety signals that a reader must not be able to miss. Until October 2026 these two schemas lived inside enrich-swarm.workflow.js, the background fan-out removed in the integrity pass (REVIEW-2026-10.md, pile one, class f); the tests read them from this file now.
